description: S50 T2 (RM1): the edit door, narrow by design — the row is retitled and EVERY column the call did not name rides on unchanged (priorityState, priorityLabel, estimate, status, provenance all byte-identical; the type cannot name them, so no caller can reach them). The audit gets ONE `update` row naming the FIELDS, never the values, never user text (RM2). `changed:true` says a row moved; the same call with the CURRENT title answers changed:false with no audit row at all — an edit that changed nothing is not an event. Status, priority, estimate and provenance are refused by key (see update-unknown-key-refused.json); artifact paths ride this door only until the item starts, and only under its own component root.
